scope: interface and storage contracts; no CAD, queue, or final-matrix edits
selected_implementation: Path A TUSB9261 + JMS583 dual-mode storage

status_definition.FAIL: current implementation contradicts the interface invariant
status_definition.UNPROVEN: required integrated, measured, firmware, procurement, or endpoint evidence is missing
status_definition.NOT_APPLICABLE: not part of selected production implementation

invariants.statement: One CM5-to-V100 lane-0 PCIe link only: PER0 P/N, PET0 P/N with source-side AC coupling, one differential REFCLK, active-low PERST; no expansion lanes, NVLink, switch, or redriver.
invariants.rationale: Matches the selected Rev A product scope and CM5 endpoint topology.
invariants.contradiction: Schematic intent exists; board-wide route/opens and endpoint enumeration remain open.

invariants.statement: J1 is Amphenol/FCI 74221-101LF, 400 contacts, 40x10, 1.27 mm pitch, 0.45 A/contact; bounded PiSXMe contract assigns 130 12V_PROTECTED, 170 POWER_GND, and A2/A3, G1/G2, E7/F7, E18 to selected x1/control signals; other contacts stay unknown/NC where unproven.
invariants.rationale: Separates manufacturer mechanical identity from reverse-engineered electrical evidence and preserves unknown contacts.
invariants.contradiction: Reverse-engineering evidence is not NVIDIA-official; K18/K19, 31 NC/project-unknown contacts, and undocumented endpoint behavior remain unproven.

invariants.statement: V100/SXM2 endpoint uses a 12 V power domain; product-level 300 W sustained and 330 W design peak are governed by the separate product/power invariant audit.
invariants.rationale: Prevents source-capacity assumptions from being inferred from J1 contact count.
invariants.responsible_authority: Power Authority with Root product authority
invariants.contradiction: Source topology and margin are outside this interface packet and remain a foundational dependency.

invariants.statement: CM5 side must provide the required PCIe x1, USB, service USB, and 5 V/logic domains; CM5IO reference supports PCIe Gen 2 x1, while Gen 3 x1 is experimental/unsupported.
invariants.rationale: Sets the supported interface generation and prevents an unsupported Gen 3 claim.
invariants.contradiction: Source topology exists; physical closure and actual operating configuration are not demonstrated.

invariants.statement: REFCLK is differential and PERST is active-low fundamental reset; no high-speed stub or extra lane/control is allowed; exact V100 reset/power timing remains empirical.
invariants.rationale: Preserves the selected PCIe endpoint contract without inventing undocumented reset behavior.
invariants.contradiction: Named nets are present; timing and endpoint enumeration remain undocumented.

invariants.statement: CM5 USB3 is a 5 Gb/s-class SuperSpeed differential RX/TX interface; P/N naming swaps are allowed only as explicit polarity-preserving routing convention.
invariants.rationale: Defines USB3 source capability and keeps naming convention distinct from electrical inversion.
invariants.contradiction: Saved pair metrics exist; no field solver, coupon, TDR, eye, or integrated closure exists.

invariants.statement: HD3SS6126/HD3SS3412 operate at 3.0-3.6 V nominal 3.3 V; control VIH >=2.0 V, VIL <=0.8 V; differential I/O 0-1.8 Vp-p, common mode 0-2 V; inactive paths must isolate.
invariants.rationale: Binds the storage switch electrical domain and mode isolation behavior.
invariants.contradiction: Schematic mode contract is explicit; integrated route and powered-state isolation are open.

invariants.statement: Selected SATA bridge is TUSB9261IPVP: USB3 up to 5 Gb/s, SATA Gen1/Gen2 up to 3 Gb/s, 1.1 V/3.3 V rails, reset held at least 2 ms after supplies valid; M-key lane uses 49/47/43/41.
invariants.rationale: Binds selected Path-A bridge and corrected M-key contact mapping.
invariants.contradiction: Source mapping is corrected; integrated route, inactive isolation, SSD behavior, and procurement remain open.

invariants.statement: Selected NVMe bridge is JMS583-QHFA3A; PCIe lane-0 pins 41/42 and 44/45, clock 47/48, reset 54, CLKREQ 55; PCIe TX coupling 220 nF and USB3 TX coupling 100 nF; never shares a bridge port with TUSB9261.
invariants.rationale: Binds selected dual-mode NVMe implementation and prevents both alternatives being built as production.
invariants.contradiction: Source contract exists; integrated route, module inrush/thermal, authorized supply, and release firmware evidence are open.

invariants.statement: FORCE SATA, FORCE NVMe, AUTO, and empty are power-off mode states; USB2/USB3 switch together; SATA OOB and PCIe electrical-idle/detect isolate; empty makes no drive-presence claim.
invariants.rationale: Prevents inactive bridge contention and ambiguous storage ownership.
invariants.contradiction: Truth table is authoritative; complete integrated switched-mode candidate has not passed.

invariants.statement: M-key shared SATA/PCIe lane uses contacts 49/47/43/41; configuration and power contacts remain explicit; stale SATA-only/B-key mapping is invalid.
invariants.rationale: Keeps physical contact mapping separate from stale route artifacts.
invariants.contradiction: Earlier route probes targeted wrong contacts; rejected probes are not authority.

invariants.statement: Service/recovery USB2 is separate from storage USB3 and retains explicit D+/D- plus recovery/control role.
invariants.rationale: Protects required service function from storage selector coupling.
invariants.contradiction: Schematic role is recorded; integrated connectivity and bring-up remain open.

invariants.statement: CM5 Ethernet is a 1:1 Gigabit path with selected magnetics, ESD, center-tap, shield, and LED support; exact TRJG0926HENL procurement/manufacturer authority is not closed.
invariants.rationale: Separates closed schematic support topology from open physical/procurement release evidence.
invariants.contradiction: Support schematic is closed; PCB materialization, exact part provenance, procurement, and link behavior remain open.

invariants.statement: 3.3 V CM5 controls are compatible with selector thresholds VIH >=2.0 V and VIL <=0.8 V at selector VDD 3.0-3.6 V; 1.8 V controls require explicit level-translation authority.
invariants.contradiction: No authority supports silently using 1.8 V controls on the 3.3 V selector inputs.

invariants.statement: TUSB9261 requires a documented TI image/config path and reset/SPI behavior; JMS583 baseline is factory mask-ROM with optional documented SPI customization; RTL9210B is not a production dependency.
invariants.rationale: Keeps firmware/procurement claims bounded and prevents hidden alternative architecture.
invariants.contradiction: Default/credible operation is not release proof; exact image provenance and functional validation remain open.

invariants.statement: RTL9210B Path B is isolated qualification evidence and not selected production implementation or a Path-A closure prerequisite.
invariants.rationale: Prevents building mutually exclusive alternatives and using isolated evidence as integrated proof.
invariants.contradiction: None for selected Path A; retain isolated evidence only.

queue_implications: Keep route-dependent packages behind foundational invariant gate and Issue #2 where applicable.
Do not promote local-fixture PASS to integrated closure.
Keep RTL9210B Path B out of selected production queue.
Route power, SI/PCIe, storage, and Ethernet open rows to their named authorities after matrix integration.
